name: Killing Me Necromantically
source:
Awaking in the dark, your sight blurred in panic, you are met with a face you recognize.  You remember her, but the images that flash in your mind the more you remember paint an entirely different picture than the person in front of you. 

[From [url=https://foeoffortune.itch.io/killing-me-necromantically]Itch.io[/url]]
